data.summary: SIRU as built (read from its code through viz-lyze and the as-built ledger): five NestJS services behind one edge gateway, three React Native apps and a Next.js ops dashboard. siru-auth-service is the gateway and the JWT issuer: it verifies the token once, strips the client's Authorization header, injects X-User-Id and X-User-Role, and routes /api/c to siru-user-service and /api/m to siru-provider-service. siru-user-service holds the buyer and merchant domain, chat and the Ask SIRU assistant (Claude Haiku 4.5, OpenAI for speech only); siru-provider-service holds stores, catalog, the order state machine and the whole money stack on Cashfree. siru-slot-service (bookings, its own database) and siru-admin-service (ops) sit off the gateway. One Postgres holds the public and provider schemas; S3 holds private media. Events are in-process and lossy, schema is boot-time DDL, and the target platform (a governed AI service, durable events, the Node and National tiers) is not built yet.

paths.name: An online order, end to end

steps.says: The buyer taps Pay; the app calls order placement with its JWT
One JWT check at the edge; X-User-Id injected, Authorization stripped
The order and its item snapshots are written; the auto-reject timer is armed
Cashfree's hosted checkout opens in a WebView
An HMAC-verified webhook confirms; the split runs during capture
The order card lands in the buyer and store chat
The merchant accepts and the order state machine moves on
The app sends a phone number; auth routes are handled at the edge
After the rate check (3 per 10 minutes) MSG91 sends the OTP
A bcrypt hash is stored and older codes are superseded
Verify: a 15-minute access token and a 7-day refresh token
Clinical grounding tables are matched against the message and the cart
Claude Haiku runs the tool loop, up to 8 rounds
The reply is sanitised, then streamed back as text and cards

crossing.rule: The edge verifies the JWT once, strips the client's Authorization header and injects X-User-Id and X-User-Role; the role is decided by the URL surface, not by the token.
Between services the internal API key is the single trust boundary: whoever holds it can set X-User-Id and is trusted as that user.
siru-slot-service and siru-admin-service sit off the gateway: the apps call them directly, and the admin service has its own email and password login.
Money is in paise integers; Cashfree's webhooks are HMAC-verified and the split runs during capture, with a nightly settlement per merchant.
A prescription-only item is hard-blocked at order placement in siru-provider-service; the assistant's Rx gate is only the user experience.
A prescription image goes to private S3, is read once by the vision model and deleted; the ruling to keep it through pharmacist verification is not in the code yet.
